tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i cho ga bzhugs so// shrī badzra bhai ra wā ya na maḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bka' sdod las kyi gshed/ /dam nyams snying dmar za ba'i 'chi bdag gtso/ /yi dwags dregs pa'i ded dpon dam can che/ /gang de'i gtor chog bri yi dgra la rol/ /'dir rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa dag gis 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas la mchod gtor 'bul bar 'dod pas thod pa dang lcags la sogs pa'i snod du nas nag po'i rjen phye khrag chang gis sbrus pa'i zan la/ gtor ma rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang yang rung ba mthong brgyud kyi lag len ltar bsham/ sha khrag sgog tsong la sogs pa'i mthun rdzas kyis sbags la dar nag po'i cod paṇa btsugs/ de'i mdun du drag po'i nyer mchod lnga khrag gi arghaṃ/ dri chab kyi mna' chu sogs nye bar mkho ba'i rdzas rnams ma tshang ba med par bshams/ de nas yi dam gyi bdag mdun mchod gtor 'bul ba'i bar legs par grub pa'i rjes su/ 'di nyid kyi gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa'i snod stong gsum gyi khyon ltar yangs pa'i nang du dgra bgegs gdug pa can ma lus pa bsad cing bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha khrag rus pa'i phung po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi mdun du khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po rba rlabs drag tu 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil du/ dus kyi me rlung dmar nag 'tshub cing 'bar ba/ bsur chen gyi dud sprin dang na bun 'thibs pa'i dbus/ keng rus kyi ri rab chen po'i steng du 'jigs rung gshin rje'i grong khyer thod pa lcags kyi pho brang chen po zlum po sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ dur khrod kyi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i phyi nang kun tu bdud dang gshin rje dang /

ma mo dang / srin po la sogs pa'i dregs pa'i tshogs dang / ro dang / ro langs dang / gcan gzan la sogs pa'i gdug pa can gyi srog chags du mas yongs su gang ba'i nang du/ gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar padma dang nyi ma dang / ro'i gdan la ma he nag po dregs shing khros pa mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du/ ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje mdog nag po srin po'i gzugs can/ ma he glang rgod khros pa'i gdong pa rwa rnon po nam mkha'i dbyings su gdengs pa la zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba/ zhal dmar po rab tu gdangs shing mche ba zangs yag tu gtsigs pa/ ljags glog ltar 'khyug cing / smin ma dang sma ra me ltar 'bar ba/ dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum dam nyams la sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ skra kham pa gzengs shing 'phyar ba/ phyag g.yas gshin rje'i thod dbyug gdengs thabs su nam mkhar 'phyar zhing / g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i dus kyi zhags pa nag po mda' ltar 'phen pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / da lta nyid du bsad cing bcad pa'i mgo rlon khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ dug sbrul nag po dang rus pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ liṅga dmar po gyen du sgreng ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing / g.yon brkyang ba'i gyad kyi dor stabs kyis ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrug pa'i dbus na ha ha'i gad rgyangs chen po rgod cing bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du rtsi dang rtse gsum yongs su gyur pa las ma ma chen mo tsa munt+ri mdog nag po srin mo khros pa'i cha lugs can/ kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pas/ khro gnyer dang bcas pa'i spyan gsum khrag mig tu blta ba ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes shing thur du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi rtse gsum 'bar ba dgra la 'debs shing /

g.yon pa dam nyams kyi snying dmar khrag dang bcas pas phyur bur gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ dud 'gro'i lpags pa rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa gos su gyon pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis me rlung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi 'khor lo'i phyogs kyi rtsibs bzhi la srog dbugs kyi bdag po khrag 'thung nag po las kyi gshed bzhi gnas pa ni/ shar du ya ba ti mthing nag g.yas 'khor lo dang / g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ seng ge dkar po la chibs pa/ 'jigs shing rngams pas rgyal po'i tshul 'dzin pa/ lhor phya bsangs mthing nag g.yas be con dang / g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ g.yu 'brug sngon po la zhon pa/ 'jigs shing rngams pa blon po'i tshul 'dzin pa/ nub tu dmigs pa mthing nag g.yas gsal shing dang / g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ mkha' lding khra bo la zhon pa/ 'jigs shing rngams pa ded dpon gyi tshul 'dzin pa/ byang du ral pa tshar dgu mthing nag g.yas mdung thung dang / g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ chu srin dmar po la zhon pa/ 'jigs shing rngams pa pho nya'i tshul 'dzin pa'o/ /'khor lo'i mtshams kyi rtsibs bzhi la za byed dmar po srid pa'i ma mo chen mo bzhi gnas pa ni/ shar lhor kā la ra tri dmar mo/ g.yas las kyi me long dang / g.yon shwa rdel dkar nag thogs pa/ lcags kyi drel rta la chibs pa/ stong gsum nyi ma'i gung la nyul ba/ lho nub tu gsod byed nag mo dmar mo/ g.yas nad kyi rkyal pa dang / g.yon shwa rdel dkar nag thogs pa/ bong bu gwa pa la chibs pa stong gsum nyi ma'i zer la nyul ba/ nub byang du nag mo chen mo dmar mo/ g.yas mtshon gyi gru gu dang / g.yon shwa rdel dkar nag thogs pa/ rlung nag 'tshub ma la zhon pa/ stong gsum nam gyi gung la nyul ba/ byang shar du nam gru chen mo dmar mo/ g.yas bdud kyi khram shing dang / g.yon shwa rdel dkar nag thogs pa/ chu bya nag mo la zhon pa/ stong gsum nam gyi tho rangs nyul ba'o/

/sgo bzhir gsod byed dkar mo sgrol ba'i 'gying bzhi gnas pa ni/ shar sgor ya ma dhu ti dkar po/ g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ rgya stag khra bo la zhon pa/ dgra bgegs thams cad 'dzin par byed pa/ lho sgor kā la pā sha dkar po g.yas zhags pa/ g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ gzig nag khros pa la zhon pa/ dgra bgegs thams cad 'ching bar byed pa/ nub sgor ya ma daṇḍi dkar po g.yas be con/ g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ dom nag snying dkar la zhon pa/ dgra bgegs thams cad gsod par byed pa/ byang sgor ya ma daṃṣṭi dkar po/ g.yas mche ba 'bar ba/ g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ dred dkar 'jigs pa la zhon pa/ dgra bgegs thams cad za bar byed pa'o/ /de rnams kyi phyi rol du dgra bo'i srog gcod gshin rje pho brgyud kyi tshogs dang / nad bdag ma mo gshin rje mo brgyud kyi tshogs dang / gzhan yang gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang bcas pa/ de thams cad kyang 'jigs shing rngams la mi sdug pa'i kha dog dang / cha lugs phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ skad cig nyid la dgra bgegs kyi srog dbugs 'phrog cing sha khrag rus pa nang khrol klad pa dang bcas pa hab kyis za zhing / hub kyis 'thung ba/ ma bsgoms par yang sgrub pa po'i las thams cad thogs med du sgrub pas nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad gang bar bsam/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros pas lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og 'jigs rung gshin rje'i grong khyer lcags mkhar sgo med mun khang bcu drug gi gnas nas dam can 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ rdo rje g.yab cing dril bu bsil kyang rung ste skabs 'dir spyan drangs pa'i be con gyi phyag rgya bstan par 'dod na/

lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong nang du bcug nas khu tshur bcing / mdzub mo bsgrengs te cung zad bskums nas lag pa 'phangs stod de 'phyar ba'o/ /yaḥ 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol na/ /thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer na/ /srog la rngams pa'i gshin rje ni/ /yi dwags kun gyi ded dpon po/ /ma mo kun gyi tshogs rje bo/ /gson gshin kun gyi zam kha ba/ /gson po skos la 'debs pa po/ /shi ba kun gyi gshin bu rje/ /dge ba kun gyi gtang 'dzin cing / /sdig pa can gyi 'chad pa mkhan/ /legs nyes chos bzhin spyod pa po/ /chos rgyal gshin rje zhes bya ba/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs can/ /'khor bcas deng 'dir bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i thugs kyi sras/ /gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bsam pa byang chub sems kyis brlan/ /rgya ni ye shes rdo rje 'chang / /gzi brjid sku gsung thugs kyis bskyed/ /don ni 'gro ba kun gyi don/ /las ni sangs rgyas kun gyi las/ /bka' ni dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'/ /chos rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /drag po'i las 'di gtad par 'dod/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /gson na sems can kun la gnod/ /dkon mchog gsum la rnam par 'tshe/ /dmigs kyi rnal 'byor yongs la sdang / /'di dag myur du bsgral ba'i phyir/ /chos rgyal 'khor bcas spyan 'dren na/ /dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ hrīḥṣṭ-iḥwi kri ta na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ kā la rū pa/ ya ma rā dza/ sa pā ri wā ra a kārṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas mdun du byon nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros gshin rje gshed rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/

oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing / bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa'i srin lag gnyis gshibs te brkyangs pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya rang gi snying gar bzhag ste bstan nas/ oṃ hrīiḥṣṭiḥwi kri ta na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ kā la rū pa/ ya ma rā dza sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod de dam la bzhag pas/ de dag gis rang la glags mi rnyed par bsam/ 'dam skyes 'dam bral mdzes pa'i kha dog can/ /'od zer 'bum ldan nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / /ma he'i glang rgod dregs shing 'gyings pa yi/ /gdan tshogs 'di ni dad pas 'bul gyis bzhes/ /oṃ hrīiḥṣṭiḥwi kri ta na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ kā la ru pa ya ma rā dzā sa pā ri wā ra/ padma surya ma he sha a sa na hūm̐/ ya ma rā dza 'khor dang bcas/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dir gdan bzhugs/ /mchod pa tshul bzhin bzhes nas kyang / /las grub bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /sngags snga ma'i rjes su tiṣṭantu sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas gdan dbul/ de nas lag pa g.yas be con gyi phyag rgya bcas/ g.yon pas khrag chang bsres pas bkang ba'i thod pa bzung la/ gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la arghaṃ gsol bas/ dmar gyi arghaṃ/ zhag gi me tog rba rlabs kyi 'phreng ba g.yo ba gting mtha' mi mngon pa/ rgya mtsho ltar zad mi shes pa 'byung bar gyur cig oṃ hrīḥṣṭīḥwi kri ta na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ kā la rū pa/ ya ma rā dza sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ pra titstsha hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod pa dbul/ yang lag pa g.yas pas sngar gyi phyag rgya dang g.yon pas me tog blangs te/ gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la me tog phul bas me tog gi khang bu brtsegs pa tog dang kha bad du ldan pa ka ba brgyad zug pa me tog gi bla re dang / gdugs dang phreng bas brgyan pa rin po che'i rang bzhin can 'byung bar gyur cig

sa pā ri wā ra yan chad sngar ltar gyi mjug tu/ badzra puṣpe pū tsa sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes pas me tog g.yas sngar ltar la/ g.yon pas sha chen gyi bdug spos bzung la/ gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la sha chen gyi bdug pa phul bas gzhal yas khang gi mgul du bdug pa'i sprin bai ḍūrya'i mdog lta bu sna tshogs la spos kyi khang bzang dri zhim pa dang ldan pa rin po che brtsigs pa'i dbyibs 'dra ba 'byung bar gyur cig badzra puṣpe pū dzā sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pas bdug spos/ g.yas sngar ltar la/ g.yon pas zhun chen gyi mar me bzung ste/ gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la mar me phul bas/ gzhal yas khang gi phyogs mtshams su mun pa drung nas 'byin pa'i snang gsal gyi gzhal yas khang kun nas 'bar ba nyin mor byed pa'i nor bu rgyas pa'i 'od la sogs pa'i snang ba 'byung bar gyur cig badzra dī paṃ pū dzā sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pas mar me/ g.yas pa sngar ltar/ g.yon pas dri chab bzung la/ gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la byug pa phul bas lus dang gnas kyi dri ma dag ste/ reg na bde ba'i reg bya dang ldan zhing dri'i mchog bsnam zhing bzod pa dang ldan pas tshim par gyur cig badzra gande pū dzā sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes pas dri chab/ g.yas sngar ltar g.yon pas zhal zas btegs la/ gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la zhal zas phul bas/ kha zas dri dang ro dang kha dog phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ bdud rtsi kha dog dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / sngon po dang ldan pa kham gyi zas la gnas pa rnams tshim par byed pa'i mthu dang ldan par 'byung bar gyur cig /badzra nai wi ti pū dzā sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pas zhal zas dang / rkang gling la sogs pa'i rol mo sna tshogs sgrog cing / gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la rol mo 'bul bas rnga dang / rnga bo che dang / rdza rnga dang / cha lang dang / dril bu dang / ḍā ma ru dang /

dkar dung dang / zangs dung dang / rkang gling dang / pi wang la sogs pa rol mo du ma'i tshogs dang / sna tshogs pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro byed pa'i sgra khams gsum kun tu gsal bar grags pa'i sgra rna bar snyan zhing 'jam pas tshim par byed pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig /badzra shapta pū dzā sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pas rol mo dbul lo/ /lag pa g.yas be con gyi phyag rgya dang / g.yon pas gtor ma bzung ba'am/ yang na lag pa gnyis rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ ai kā la ru pa ya ma rā dza sa pā ri wā ra sarba bighnan sha truṃ ma rā ya ī daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsa munt+ri sa pā ri wā ra man chad sngar ltar sbyar ba gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma dbul/ oṃ kā la ru pa ya ma rā dza sa pā ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod dbul/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rjes lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyis gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen sel/ mthun rkyen sgrubs/ sdang zhing gdug pa'i sems 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad da lta nyid du thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod cig zhes brjod cing thal mo gdab/ de nas/ yaḥ'achi bdag nag po lho phyogs kyi/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa bya bar 'dod pas/ rang gshin rje gshed du gsal ba'i snying ga nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros pas/ las gshin 'khor bcas kyi thugs kar phog pa'i mod la 'dar zhing skrag la khro zhing 'khrugs pas las thams cad thogs med du sgrub par bsam la oṃ kā la rū pa hūm̐ phaṭa zhes dang / oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ kā la rū pa bhi ma yakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ a ti pa ta ye/ ya ma rā dza ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

'di gsum gang yang rung ba'i snying po yin pas ci nus bzlas shing mthar oṃ kā la rū pa bhi ma yakṣa hūm̐/ ma hā ro ṣa na na ra siddhi ya sarba bhū ta a ti pa ta ye/ ya ma rā dzā ye hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes snying po dang / oṃ tsa munt+ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yum gyi snying po'ang ci nus bzla'o/ /bsnyen pa'i tshe snying po gang yang rung ba 'bum phrag bzhi dang / nye ba'i snying po 'bum phrag gcig bzla ba ni grangs kyi bsnyen pa dang / gtso bor ni rtags sam mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa nyid bzung ngo / /de nas phyi nang gi mchod pa mdor bsdus phul la/ bstod cing bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ chos dbyings spros dang bral ba'i nam mkha' la/ /thugs rje thabs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /dur khrod nag po 'jigs byed rngams pa'i gzugs/ /gzi brjid 'bar ba'i sku gcig shar ba ni/ /ma chags padma nyi ma'i gdan steng du/ /ma he glang rgod khros pa'i khri steng na/ /ya las byung ba'i thod dbyug 'phro 'du las/ /'jigs byed chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis thod dbyug 'bar ba bsnams/ /dgra bgegs ma lus zil gyis gnon par mdzad/ /dug sbrul khros pa'i zhags pa g.yon na 'dzin/ /dam nyams ma lus mgul nas 'ching bar byed/ /rngams pa'i zhal gdangs mi sdug gzugs 'chang ba/ /lha chen dpal 'bar nag po khrag la rol/ /mgrin par hūm̐ gi 'brug sgra zab mo sgrog /mche ba zangs yag gangs ri'i phreng ba gtsigs/ /ljags kyi glog 'phreng dmar po glog ltar 'khyug /sma ra smin ma bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar/ /khro gnyer chu 'dzin mun pa'i dmag dpung 'khrigs/ /spyan gsum 'od 'bar nyi zla zil gyis gnon/ /stod g.yogs dar nag na bun gyen du g.yo/ /smad g.yogs stag lpags khrag char thur du 'bab/ /sbrul rus gza' skar skar mda' 'khrug cing spro/ /rtse gsum thod khrag 'dzin byed bu yug 'tshub/ /dbyings las sprul pa'i mgon po yab yum gyis/

/gdug pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol bar mdzod/ /khrag 'thung nag po las kyi gshed bzhi ni/ /'khor lo be con gsal shing mdung thung 'dzin/ /seng ge 'brug dang mkha' lding chu srin zhon/ /phyogs bzhi'i sprul pas dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod/ /za byed dmar mo srid pa'i ma bzhi ni/ /me long nad rkyal gru gu khram shing 'dzin/ /drel rta bong bu shwa ba chu bya zhon/ /mtshams bzhi'i sprul pas dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod/ /gsod byed dkar po sgrol ba'i gying bzhi ni/ /lcags kyu zhags pa dbyug pa mche ba 'dzin/ /stag gzig dom dred khros pa'i gcan gzan zhon/ /sgo bzhi'i sprul pas dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang gza' brgyad lha klu brgyad/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad/ /khams gsum srid pa'i dregs pa thams cad kyis/ /dgra bgegs ma lus kun tu bsgral bar mdzod/ /sngon tshe 'jam dpal spyan sngar dam bcas pa/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring skyong ba dang / /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor thams cad kyi/ /sgrub par bar chad ma lus zhi bar mdzod/ /de nas 'khor rnams bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /shar phyogs las kyi gshed po ni/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po ya ba ti/ /mthing nag 'bar ba 'khor lo 'dzin/ /'jigs shing rngam pa rgyal po'i tshul/ /srog dbugs bdag po dgra la rol/ /chibs su seng ge dkar mo chibs/ /shar gyi dgra bgegs 'dul mdzad pa/ /khyod la gnyer du gtad pa ni/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /'di dag 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /khyod kyis gsad cing bsgral bar gyis/ /gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /lho phyogs las kyi gshed po ni/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po phya bsangs te/ /mthing nag 'bar ba be con 'dzin/ /'jigs shing rngams pa blon po'i tshul/ /srog dbugs bdag po khrag la rol/ /chibs su g.yu 'brug sngon po chibs/

/lho yi dgra bgegs 'dul mdzad pa/ /khyod… bstan… 'di… khyod kyis… gzhan yang 'khor… nub… gshin rje'i rgyal po dmigs pa ste/ /mthing nag 'bar ba gsal shing 'dzin/ /'jigs shing rngams pa ded dpon tshul/ /srog dbugs bdag po khrag la rol/ /chibs su mkha' lding khra bo chibs/ /nub kyi… khyod la… bstan pa… 'di dag… khyod kyis… gzhan yang… byang phyogs las kyi gshed po ni/ /gshin rje ral pa tshar dgu ldan/ /mthing nag 'bar ba mdung thung 'dzin/ /'jigs shing rngams pa pho nya'i tshul/ /srog dbugs bdag po dgra la rol/ /chibs su chu srin dmar po chibs/ /byang gi… khyod la… bstan pa… 'di dag… khyod kyis… gzhan yang khyod kyi bka' 'khor na/ /shar lhor srid pa'i ma mo ni/ /kā la ra tri zhes bya ba/ /dmar mo mi sdug 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /phyag g.yas las kyi me long dang / /g.yon pa shwa rdel dkar nag thogs/ /chibs su drel rta rkang gsum chibs/ /stong gsum nyi ma'i gung la nyul/ /khyod la… bstan pa… 'di dag… khyod kyis… gzhan yang… lho nub srid pa'i ma mo ni/ /gsod byed nag mo zhes bya ba/ /dmar mo mi sdug 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /phyag g.yas nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams/ /g.yon pa shwa rdel dkar nag thogs/ /chibs su bong bu gwa dmar chibs/ /stong gsum nyi ma'i zer la nyul/ khyod la… bstan pa… 'di dag… khyod kyis… gzhan yang… nub byang srid pa'i ma mo ni/ /nag mo chen mo zhes bya ba/ /dmar mo mi sdug 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /phyag g.yas mtshon gyi gru gu dang / /g.yon pa shwa sdel dkar nag thogs/ /chibs su rlung nag 'tshub ma chibs/ /stong gsum nam gyi gung la nyul/ /khyod la… bstan pa… 'di dag… khyod kyis… /gzhan yang khyod kyi bka' 'khor na/ /byang shar srid pa'i ma mo ni/ /nam gru chen mo zhes bya ba/ /dmar mo mi sdug 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram bam bsnams/ /g.yon pa shwa sdel dkar nag thogs/ /chibs su chu bya nag mo chibs/

/stong gsum nam gyi tho rangs nyul/ /khyod la gnyer du gtad pa ni/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /'di dag 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /khyod kyis gsad cing bsgral bar gyis/ /hūm̐/ gzhan yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /shar phyogs sgrol ba'i gying po ni/ /ya ma du ti zhes bya ba/ /dkar po mi sdug lcags kyu 'dzin/ /gang zhig bzung bar 'dod pa de/ /g.yugs pa tsam gyis 'dzin par byed/ /chibs su rgya stag khra bo chibs/ /dgra bgegs thams cad 'dzin par byed/ /khyod la… bstan… 'di dag… khyod kyis… gzhan yang… lho sgor sgrol ba'i gying po ni/ /kā la pā sha zhes bya ba/ /dkar po mi sdug zhags pa 'dzin/ /gang zhig 'ching bar 'dod pa de/ /btab pa tsam gyis 'ching bar byed/ /chibs su gzig nag khros pa chibs/ /dgra bgegs thams cad 'ching mdzad pa/ /khyed la… bstan pa… 'di dag… khyod kyis… gzhan yang… /nub sgor sgrol ba'i gying po ni/ /ya ma danti zhes bya ba/ /dkar po mi sdug be con 'dzin/ /gang zhig gsod par 'dod pa de/ /'phyar ba tsam gyis 'chi bar byed/ /chibs su dom nag snying dkar chibs/ /dgra bgegs thams cad gsod mdzad pa/ /khyod la… bstan pa… 'di dag… khyod kyis… gzhan yang… /byang sgor sgrol ba'i gying po ni/ /ya ma dant+ri zhes bya ba/ /dkar po mi sdug mche ba 'dzin/ /gang zhig za bar 'dod pa de/ /gtsigs pa tsam gyis za bar byed/ /chibs su drel rta 'jigs pa chibs/ /dgra bgegs thams cad gsol mdzad pa/ /khyod la… bstan pa… 'di dag… khyod kyis gsad cing bsgral bar gyis/ /de nas lho phyogs la sogs pa gtsang sar btang ba'am/ dgra bgegs kyi phyogs su zor du 'phen na cung zad phyir sgur la/ yaḥ bcom ldan gshin rje gshed po'i bka'/ /chos kyi rgyal po dgongs su gsol/ /zhes sogs kyis gtad gnyer drag tu byas/ oṃ kā la ru pa ya ma rā dza sa pā ri wā ra mahā rakta arghaṃ pra titstsha ye hūm̐/ zhes pas gtor ma la khrag gis arghaṃ lan gsum bsgrengs pas gshin rje 'khor bcas dgra bgegs kyi khrag dron mo'i btung bas myos nas 'jigs pa'i nga ro chen po sgrag par bsam la/

dri chab bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba'i nang du rdo rje bcug ste/ oṃ badzra u ta ka hūm̐ ṭha ṭha/ zhes lan gsum la sogs pa bzlas shing / gtor ma'i steng du rdo rje bzhag dri chab blug pas gshin rje 'khor bcas kyi ljags thog tu dam tshig gi bdud rtsi byin/ snying gar ye shes kyi rdo rje me 'bar ba re re byung bas sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran nas bdag gis bsgo ba'i drag po'i las thams cad da lta nyid du sgrub par bsam la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje'i bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /gal te dam tshig 'das gyur na/ /'jam dpal rdo rje khros nas ni/ /snying ga nas ni gshegs par 'gyur/ /oṃ badzra u da ka ṭha ṭha/ sngon gyi dam tshig dran bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i tha tshig 'di mnan pas/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i tha tshig 'di/ /khyed kyi snying la gnas par gyur/ /oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha/ zhes brjod cing / tsham rngams dang bcas pas gtor ma man ngag ltar dgra phyogs su 'phang / oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dzā sa pā ri wā ra gatstsha/ zhes pas gshin rje ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs pa sogs kyis cho ga spyi ltar bya'o/ /de ltar las kyi gshin rje gshed 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i cho ga 'di ni thar pa gling pa arya de bas mdzad pa'i las gshin lha bcu gsum pa'i mchod 'phreng gi yi ge la gzhi blangs/ rwa chen dang bu ston rin po che sogs kyi yi ges kyang cung zad gsal bar byas nas/ las dang po pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa rnams la phan pa'i slad du gshin rje gshed ma he'i zhal gyi rnal 'byor pa blo gsal rgya mtshos 'dar stod gangs can ri bo'i rang gi bsam gtan gyi khang bu kun gsal bde chen pho brang du legs par sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa'i dgra bo thams cad myur du tshar gcod par gyur cig/
